scene_en: A women's majlis of 5 by 7 metres in warm modern style, no television anywhere. West and east long walls: two beige three-seat fabric sofas with slim wooden legs on each wall facing each other; north wall: a third beige sofa centred under a wide window with beige pinch-pleat curtains over sheer cream curtains. Centre: two rectangular walnut coffee tables in a row on two large low-pile beige berber-style rugs. Walls in warm washed-linen off-white, the north window wall in a soft cashew-beige accent colour, light beige wood-look plank floor, ceiling with a warm hidden LED cove, two linen drum pendant lamps above the coffee tables. South wall beside the door: a slim built-in oak coffee station with a round oak-framed mirror above it. Styled and lived-in but tidy: on each sofa three cushions in off-white, natural geometric weave and olive green, a folded throw on one armrest; on the coffee tables a wooden tray with a brass dallah and small cups, a low bowl of dates, a stack of two books and a small glass vase of fresh white flowers; a tall capiz-shell vase with dried pampas in one corner; rice-paper floor lamps in two corners; a large framed abstract artwork in earthy tones on the west wall. Soft late-afternoon daylight mixed with warm lamp light, calm and hospitable, no people.
